As a first-time sole trader with simple income, the **Self Assessment Simple** package at **£119 per tax year** would likely be the most suitable option for you. This package is designed for straightforward tax situations and should cover your needs effectively.

If you have any specific questions about what the package includes or about the Self Assessment process itself, feel free to ask! You can also find more details about the package [here](https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/self-assessment).

As a landlord needing to comply with Making Tax Digital (MTD), the lowest suitable Simbian plan is **Simbian Comply**, which costs **£29.99 per month** (VAT included). This plan includes the necessary digital bookkeeping services, quarterly MTD updates, and year-end Self Assessment preparation, all subject to your responsibilities for providing timely records.
